wave: Phase B final wave -- cache + washington (2026-08-23)
method: pdftoppm full-page render + Read tool (Claude Code allotment; no Anthropic API)

contributions.basis: cover-line1 (the only anchor; this form generation prints no schedule total)
contributions.detail: Form A (p2) verified BLANK at 200dpi across all ~44 ruled lines. Cover lines 1 and 2 are struck zero glyphs in all six cells, so 0.00 is exact and, LAST being zero, the THIS and CUMULATIVE scopes coincide - this is the filer's first report of the 2010 cycle. schedule_total is null because the field does not exist on the Carr 5-5-PG sheet, not because it was illegible.

expenditures.basis: cover-line3-this == cover-line3-cumulative (no schedule total exists on this form)
expenditures.detail: Three Form B rows sum to exactly 500.00 = the cover line-3 THIS cell = the CUMULATIVE cell. Line 3's LAST cell was first written '500.00' then HEAVILY SCRIBBLED OUT and replaced with a struck zero glyph above it - the correction is the filer's and I read the corrected value (0), which is also what makes the line's own arithmetic close (0 + 500.00 = 500.00). First report of the cycle, so the two scopes coincide - recorded cumulative.

gates.page_subtotal: NO printed schedule total exists on either sheet of this form generation, so no page-subtotal gate could be run - stated rather than invented. The gate that DID fire is the cover: p3 rows 75.00 + 400.00 + 25.00 = 500.00 = cover line 3 THIS and CUMULATIVE, exact.
gates.row_count: rowbands.py p3 returns geometry_status 'gaps' (26 bands; the Carr sheet's fine single rules are only partly detected: band 1 y=6.56 h=5.16 spans the header block, then a clean 2.32pct pitch from y=11.71). Counted against INK at 200dpi instead: exactly 3 inked lines, each with a date, a payee, a purpose and an amount, and every ruled line below is empty. Field-shift screen: 3 dates, 3 names, 3 purposes, 3 amounts - counts match; no name cell holds date-shaped content and no date cell holds name-shaped content.
gates.geometry_proof: p3 first-row amount crop (x1370 y145 W200 H55 @200dpi) renders '75 00'; second-row crop (y198) renders '400 00'; last-row crop (y253) renders '25 00'; control one row-pitch below the last (y306) renders EMPTY (bare rule).
gates.balance_chain: Cover line 4: LAST a struck zero glyph, THIS '(500.00)', CUM '(500.00)' - accounting PARENTHESES, i.e. NEGATIVE five hundred. 0 (beginning) + 0 (contributions) - 500.00 (expenditures) = -500.00 = the printed ending balance. Closes exactly, sign and all. No other filing by this filer in this cycle is in my chunk, so no cross-filing chain check was possible.

escalation_note: p3 amount column at 1200dpi with an ImageMagick -normalize pass (the scan is faint), plus four separate 200dpi cell crops for the geometry proof; the cover anchor grid cropped twice at 400dpi (lines 1-2, then lines 2-4). THE DECIDING CHECK WAS ARITHMETIC, NOT RESOLUTION: row 1's leading digit is a bistable open-top glyph that the 1200dpi normalized crop still left arguable between 7 and 2, and row 3's leading digit is an unambiguous 2 of visibly different shape. 75 + 400 + 25 = 500.00 closes on the cover; 25 + 400 + 25 = 450.00 does not. The value is 75.00 - the document's own arithmetic settling a glyph, exactly the Rhodes pattern. The 200dpi cell crop independently reads '75'.
notes: OFFICE VERIFIED IN THE DOCUMENT: 'Name of Office: WASHINGTON County Clerk/Auditor', 'Office District: County', 'Political Party: Republican' - a county row office, in scope, and it agrees with the chunk file's 'Clerk/Auditor'. Candidate 'KIM M HAFEN' agrees. Note the recursion: Kim Hafen is the very County Clerk/Auditor to whom the other filings in this chunk are addressed; here she files as a candidate and the RECEIVED APR 7 2010 stamp is her own office's. Signed 4/7/10; the form has NO period-beginning/ending line at all in this generation (the Carr 5-5-PG cover carries only a signature date) - that is a FORM LIMIT, not a lost crop, and it is why no reporting period is recorded here. PRIVACY: the cover prints home street address, city, ZIP, home phone and business phone in the clear - all discarded; there are no donor rows, and the three vendor rows carry no personal data. Channel is state_disclosures (a state-held copy of a county filing), page rot 0 and page size 595x789pt, so this PDF renders 1683x2200 at 200dpi - slightly narrower than the letter-size scans elsewhere in the chunk; the pct: geometry is relative to THAT frame.

expenditures.note: Amount written '75' with superscript cents '00' over a short rule = 75.00. The leading digit is a bistable open-top glyph; escalation to 1200dpi did NOT settle it, the filing's arithmetic did (75+400+25=500.00 = the cover's expense line; a 2 would give 450 and break it). Row 3 on the same page shows this filer's unambiguous '2', which is a different shape. Confidence on the amount held at medium for that reason. This form generation has no in-kind column.
Amount written '400' with superscript cents '00' = 400.00. The candidate's own filing fee, paid to the county.
Amount written '25' with superscript cents '00' = 25.00. Payee written out in full (not a ditto of row 1).
